tagline: Realize the extraordinary power of everyday care.
hero_kpi_rationale: Net Sales is the primary indicator of Kenvue's financial performance, reflecting its position as the world's largest pure-play consumer health company with $15.1 billion in sales in 2025.

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Total amount of sales after deductions for returns and discounts.
kpis.description: Kenvue ranks as the world's largest pure-play consumer health company by revenue, with $15.1 billion in sales in 2025.
kpis.signal: World's largest pure-play consumer health company.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €27.08 billion in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €8.67 billion in the latest year

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last four fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $0.416 in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $1.581 billion in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last four fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Portion of net income distributed as dividends: 107.6% in the latest year.

kpis.name: Separation-related costs
kpis.explanation: One-time costs incurred during the company's spin-off from its parent company.
kpis.description: These costs relate to Kenvue's transformation into an independent public company following its separation from Johnson & Johnson. IT-related disentanglement costs are substantially complete. However, costs related to legal entity name changes and other separation activities are expected to continue longer than anticipated.
kpis.signal: IT costs substantially complete, other costs continuing longer than expected.

kpis.name: Proposed Transaction with Kimberly-Clark
kpis.explanation: Acquisition of Kenvue by Kimberly-Clark for 0.14625 K-C shares and $3.50 in cash per Kenvue share.
kpis.description: The merger agreement with Kimberly-Clark was approved by the board of directors in November 2025 and by shareholders in January 2026. The Hart-Scott-Rodino waiting period expired in February 2026. The transaction is expected to close in the second half of 2026, subject to additional regulatory approvals under U.S. antitrust laws and other international regulatory clearances.
kpis.signal: Transaction approved by shareholders in January 2026, Hart-Scott-Rodino expired February 2026, expected closing H2 2026.

risks.title: Failure or delay of the merger with Kimberly-Clark
risks.score_rationale: Failure or delay of the merger with Kimberly-Clark could have severe consequences on the stock value, lead to the loss of key personnel, and disrupt operations. This is a major risk repeatedly mentioned in the report, particularly regarding the inability to achieve projected benefits and cost synergies. The merger represents a major strategic transformation for Kenvue.

risks.title: Loss of key personnel
risks.score_rationale: Uncertainties associated with the proposed transaction could lead to the loss of key personnel, which could significantly impact operations and the success of integration. This risk is explicitly mentioned in the context of the merger.

risks.title: Regulation and litigation related to acetaminophen
risks.score_rationale: Regulatory actions and ongoing litigation concerning acetaminophen (active ingredient in Tylenol) could significantly impact the company, including costs and reputation. In September 2025, U.S. federal authorities alleged a potential link between in utero exposure to acetaminophen and increased risk of neurological disorders. Citizen petitions were filed in September and November 2025 to change product labeling.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and disentanglement of IT systems
risks.score_rationale: Cybersecurity incidents could significantly impact the company, including reputation and costs. This risk is particularly relevant given the ongoing disentanglement of IT systems from Johnson & Johnson. Although separation-related IT costs are substantially complete, the integration of independent systems represents a transitional vulnerability.

risks.title: Competition in consumer health
risks.score_rationale: Competition could significantly impact the company, including market share and pricing in the consumer health sector. This risk is inherent to Kenvue's leadership position in a highly competitive sector with numerous international players and generic brands.

ai_positioning.summary: The company KVUE does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.
